[package]
name = "libsignal-core"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = ["Signal Messenger LLC"]
license = "AGPL-3.0-only"
edition = "2024"

[lints.clippy]
cast_possible_truncation = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(fuzzing)", "cfg(tokio_unstable)"]

[dependencies]
displaydoc = "0.2.5"
log = "0.4.21"
rand = "0.9"
sha2 = "0.10"
subtle = "2.6"
thiserror = "2.0.11"
uuid = "1.5"

[dependencies.libsignal-debug]
path = "rust/debug"

[dependencies.curve25519-dalek]
features = ["digest"]
version = "4.1.3"

[dependencies.derive_more]
features = ["from", "into", "try_from"]
version = "2.0.0"

[dependencies.x25519-dalek]
features = ["static_secrets"]
version = "2.0.0"

[dependencies.zerocopy]
features = ["derive"]
version = "0.8.24"

[dev-dependencies]
assert_matches = "1.5"
const-str = "1.0"
criterion = "0.5"
hex = "0.4.3"
proptest = "1.7"

[dev-dependencies.boring]
version = "5.0"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.boring-sys]
version = "5.0"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.clap]
features = ["derive"]
version = "4.4.11"

[[bench]]
name = "curve"
harness = false

[package]
name = "libsignal-debug"
edition = "2024"
version = "0.90.0"
authors = ["Signal Messenger LLC"]
license = "AGPL-3.0-only"
rust-version = "1.88"

[dependencies]
cfg-if = "1.0.0"

[lints.clippy]
cast_possible_truncation = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(fuzzing)", "cfg(tokio_unstable)"]

[features]
enabled = []

[package]
name = "libsignal-protocol"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = ["Signal Messenger LLC"]
license = "AGPL-3.0-only"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85"

[lints.clippy]
cast_possible_truncation = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(fuzzing)", "cfg(tokio_unstable)"]

[dependencies]
aes-gcm-siv = "0.11.1"
assert_matches = "1.5"
async-trait = "0.1.79"
bitflags = "2.9"
const-str = "1.0"
data-encoding-macro = "0.1.18"
derive-where = "1.2.7"
displaydoc = "0.2.5"
hex = "0.4.3"
hkdf = "0.12"
hmac = "0.12.0"
indexmap = "2.1.0"
itertools = "0.14.0"
log = "0.4.21"
prost = "0.14"
rand = "0.9"
rayon = "1.8.0"
sha2 = "0.10"
subtle = "2.6"
thiserror = "2.0.11"
uuid = "1.5"

[dependencies.libsignal-core]
path = "rust/core"

[dependencies.libsignal-debug]
path = "rust/debug"

[dependencies.signal-crypto]
path = "rust/crypto"

[dependencies.aes]
features = ["zeroize"]
version = "0.8.3"

[dependencies.ctr]
features = ["zeroize"]
version = "0.9.2"

[dependencies.derive_more]
features = ["deref", "from", "into", "try_from"]
version = "2.0.0"

[dependencies.libcrux-ml-kem]
features = ["kyber", "mlkem1024"]
version = "0.0.8"
default-features = false

[dependencies.serde]
features = ["derive"]
version = "1.0.203"

[dependencies.spqr]
git = "https://github.com/signalapp/SparsePostQuantumRatchet.git"
tag = "v1.5.1"

[dependencies.zerocopy]
features = ["derive"]
version = "0.8.24"

[features]
kyber768 = ["libcrux-ml-kem/kyber", "libcrux-ml-kem/mlkem768"]
mlkem1024 = []

[dev-dependencies]
criterion = "0.5"
env_logger = "0.11.7"
futures-util = "0.3"
proptest = "1.7"
proptest-arbitrary-interop = "0.1.0"
rand_chacha = "0.9"
rand_core = "0.9"

[dev-dependencies.libsignal-protocol-test-support]
path = "test-support"

[dev-dependencies.clap]
features = ["derive"]
version = "4.4.11"

[dev-dependencies.curve25519-dalek]
features = ["digest"]
version = "4.1.3"

[build-dependencies]
prost-build = "0.14"

[[bench]]
name = "session"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "ratchet"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "sealed_sender"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "kem"
harness = false
required-features = ["kyber768"]

[package]
name = "signal-crypto"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = ["Signal Messenger LLC"]
license = "AGPL-3.0-only"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85"

[lints.clippy]
cast_possible_truncation = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(fuzzing)", "cfg(tokio_unstable)"]

[dependencies]
derive_more = "2.0.0"
displaydoc = "0.2.5"
hkdf = "0.12"
hpke-rs = "0.6.1"
hpke-rs-crypto = "0.6.1"
rand_chacha = "0.9"
rand_core = "0.9"
sha1 = "0.10"
sha2 = "0.10"
subtle = "2.6"
thiserror = "2.0.11"
zeroize = "1.8.2"

[dependencies.libsignal-core]
path = "rust/core"

[dependencies.libsignal-debug]
path = "rust/debug"

[dependencies.aes]
features = ["zeroize"]
version = "0.8.3"

[dependencies.cbc]
features = ["std", "zeroize"]
version = "0.1.2"

[dependencies.ctr]
features = ["zeroize"]
version = "0.9.2"

[dependencies.ghash]
features = ["zeroize"]
version = "0.5.0"

[dependencies.hmac]
features = ["reset"]
version = "0.12.0"

[dev-dependencies]
assert_matches = "1.5"
const-str = "1.0"
criterion = "0.5"
hex = "0.4.3"
rand = "0.9"
serde = "1.0.203"
serde_json = "1.0.45"

[[bench]]
name = "aes_gcm"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "hpke"
harness = false

[package]
name = "spqr"
version = "1.5.1"
edition = "2021"
license = "AGPL-3.0-only"
rust-version = "1.83.0"

[dependencies]
displaydoc = "0.2"
hax-lib = "0.3.6"
hkdf = "0.12"
libcrux-hmac = "0.0.6"
log = "0.4.21"
num_enum = "0.7.3"
prost = "0.14.1"
rand = "0.9"
rand_core = "0.9"
sha2 = "0.10"
sorted-vec = "0.8.6"
thiserror = "2.0.11"

[dependencies.curve25519-dalek]
version = "4.1.3"
features = ["rand_core"]

[dependencies.libcrux-ml-kem]
version = "0.0.8"
default-features = false
features = ["incremental", "mlkem768"]

[dev-dependencies]
env_logger = "0.11"
galois_field_2pm = "0.1.0"
hex = "0.4"
hmac = "0.12.1"
matches = "0.1.10"
proptest = "1.7"
rand_distr = "0.5.1"

[dev-dependencies.spqr]
path = "."
features = ["test-utils"]

[dev-dependencies.rand_08]
package = "rand"
version = "0.8"

[build-dependencies]
prost-build = "0.14.1"

[features]
proof = []
test-utils = []

[target."cfg(not(any(windows, target_arch = \"x86\")))".dependencies.sha2]
version = "0.10"
features = ["asm"]

[target."cfg(any(target_arch = \"aarch64\", target_arch = \"x86_64\", target_arch = \"x86\"))".dependencies]
cpufeatures = "0.2"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(hax)"]

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/signalapp/libsignal"]
git = "https://github.com/signalapp/libsignal"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v0.90.0"

[source."https://github.com/signalapp/sparsepostquantumratchet"]
git = "https://github.com/signalapp/sparsepostquantumratchet"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v1.5.1"
